contract.task_clause:
Bale Co. incurred $100,000 of acquisition costs related to the purchase of the net assets of Dixon Co. The $100,000 should be
Option A: Allocated on a pro rata basis to the nonmonetary assets acquired.
Option B: Capitalized as part of goodwill and tested annually for impairment
Option C: Capitalized as an other asset and amortized over five years.
Option D: Expensed as incurred in the current period
